text.name: Populist Wave
text.rules: Record "ballot shock". SAE chooses: Amplify it online? If yes, SAE spends 1 point, then until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1; if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: The United Kingdom voted to leave the European Union on 23 June 2016 by 51.9 per cent to 48.1, and on 1 June 2018 a coalition of the Five Star Movement and the League took office in Italy. On 6 January 2021 a crowd stormed the US Capitol during the certification of the presidential election; on 8 January 2023 supporters of Brazil's defeated former president stormed the country's Congress, Supreme Court and presidential palace.
